facts.fact: The OpenMRS Talk post says the Uganda Ministry of Health has embarked on digitalising 500 health facilities with point-of-care EMRs and has directed METS to roll out UgandaEMR+ to 10 sites, with a national coordination committee set up.
facts.system: Ministry of Health EMR rollout (500 facilities)

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health aims to take 500 facilities (regional referrals, general hospitals, HCIVs) to less-paper or paperless point-of-care EMRs by end-2026, per the OpenMRS Talk post.
facts.system: Ministry of Health EMR rollout (500 facilities)

systems.tiers: HIV and TB clinics; activated at 3 of 10 target facilities in March 2024

UGA.note: UgandaEMR+ is described for HIV and TB clinics, a one-programme tracker, so its activations and 1,700-facility upgrade are not recorded.
